result.summary: The page is generally well rendered, but horizontal content is clipped at the right edge and the lower restaurant card is obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The horizontal category row is cut off at the right edge: a partial pill is visible after “Healthy,” with no clear indication or padding for additional categories.
issues.suggestion: Use a horizontally scrollable carousel with intentional end padding and/or a visible affordance that communicates more categories are available.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel is clipped on the right; the third card’s image, title (“Trattoria Picco…”), and delivery text extend beyond the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Constrain carousel card widths and provide right-side viewport padding so partial cards look intentional, or ensure all displayed card content remains within the viewport.

issues.description: The next restaurant card in “Popular right now” is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation, making its content inaccessible/obscured while scrolling to the bottom of the view.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the navigation height, and ensure scrolling content clears the fixed navigation bar.
